instruction: You are a strategic corporate innovation advisor. Analyse the company profile and survey responses, then respond ONLY with a valid JSON object containing maturity_score, opportunities, next_steps, and key_weaknesses.

answers.companyDescription: Crest Networks is a diversified holding company spanning industrial packaging, specialty chemicals, and food ingredients. The portfolio consists of six operating companies with combined revenues of €180M, managed by a central corporate team focused on high-level strategy. We are currently evaluating cross-portfolio digital transformation initiatives and shared services platforms to drive consolidated operational savings.
answers.pastInitiatives: We launched a digital customer onboarding flow last quarter that reduced average onboarding time from 12 days to 5 days, demonstrating clear efficiency gains. This project involved cross-functional input from product and compliance teams, resulting in early NPS scores for new customers onboarded through this flow that were 22 points higher than the legacy process.
answers.strategicGoals: The board has set an aggressive target to improve EBITDA margins by 500 basis points within three years, necessitating a highly disciplined, data-driven approach to cost driver identification. We are open to technology investment that demonstrably reduces unit costs or eliminates manual touchpoints, provided every project demonstrates a clear ROI timeline of under twelve months.
answers.additionalContext: We completed a merger with a similarly-sized competitor four months ago and are currently integrating teams, systems, and processes. This has created significant duplication across two CRMs and HR systems, creating a unique window to redesign core processes from scratch.
answers.teamSize: The founder handles all product and technology decisions personally, supplemented by occasional input from a part-time freelance developer. There is no formal engineering team; technical work is either performed by the founder or outsourced on a project basis, limiting dedicated innovation bandwidth.

opportunities.title: Shared Services Platform for Finance and HR Integration
opportunities.rationale: Implementing a centralized platform to manage duplicated back-office functions (like finance reporting and HR systems) directly addresses the 'efficiency' priority by eliminating redundant software licensing costs. This is an incremental move that requires relatively low technical risk but offers predictable, quantifiable cost savings.

first_actions: Conduct a detailed audit of all current back-office software subscriptions and manual data entry points.
Identify the most immediate overlap between two CRMs or HR systems for consolidation review.
execution_plan.success_metric: 30% reduction in duplicated software licensing fees within 6 months
milestones: Q2: Select and scope the integration platform.

opportunities.title: Lean, Outsourced QC Automation Pilot (IoT/ML)
opportunities.rationale: Given the micro-company structure and conservative risk appetite, a bold attempt to use low-cost IoT sensors or simple machine learning models to automate quality control checks on one high-volume product line could drastically reduce manual inspection costs. While technically challenging due to lack of internal engineering, the potential for massive unit cost reduction justifies focused, limited investment.

first_actions: Select one high-volume packaging line as a pilot target.
Identify existing data streams (e.g., machine error logs) suitable for simple anomaly detection.
execution_plan.success_metric: 15% reduction in scrap/rework rate on pilot line within 9 months
milestones: Q3: Define scope and select hardware/software stack.
Q4: Deploy and measure initial efficiency gains.

next_steps.action: Form a cross-functional efficiency task force to map all current operational costs and identify the top three manual touchpoints for automation.
Conduct a pilot project feasibility study (radical) for IoT QC in one product line, focusing strictly on low-cost entry points and measuring ROI against budget constraints.
Implement a standardized process documentation review to address cultural integration friction and clarify new cross-portfolio operational handoffs.

key_weaknesses: Severe constraint on technical bandwidth leading to reliance on founder expertise which limits scalable digital initiatives.
Fragile organizational culture and change fatigue resulting from the recent merger integration efforts.
Limited capital (€3 budget percentage) making significant, long-term R&D or large system overhauls extremely risky under a conservative mandate.
Lack of formal engineering structure means innovation projects cannot easily transition from concept to robust execution.
